versions.content: Shall be able to standardize architecture Type: valid Description: The Standardization Template shall be able to express standardization of components and communication, even if AUTOSAR does not standardize architecture of application software. This requirement covers a set of communicating components. Rationale: This allows to leverage AUTOSAR standardization principles inside a company. Use Case: [UC_STDT_00010] Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
